name: Ironbound Sentinel
languages: understands the languages of its creator but can't speak

abilities.name: Siege Monster
abilities.description: The sentinel deals double damage to objects and structures.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.description: The sentinel makes two Slam attacks. It can replace one attack with a use of Shoulder the line.

actions.name: Slam
actions.description: Melee Weapon Attack: +8 to hit, reach 10 ft., one target. Hit: 25 (6d6 + 4) bludgeoning damage.

actions.name: Trampling Press (Recharge 5-6)
actions.description: Each creature in a 30-foot cone must make a DC 16 Constitution saving throw, taking 66 (12d10) bludgeoning damage on a failed save, or half as much damage on a successful one. On a failed save, the target is also knocked prone.

actions.name: Shoulder the Line
actions.description: Each creature in a 30-foot-long, 5-foot-wide line must succeed on a DC 16 Dexterity saving throw or take 24 (7d6) bludgeoning damage, be pushed up to 10 feet straight away from the sentinel, and be knocked prone.

condition_immunities: charmed, exhaustion, frightened, paralyzed, petrified, poisoned

generation.userConcept: a sentinel of black iron, AC 20, Huge, speed 20 feet
generation.cite: composition after Clay Golem / Stone Golem (CR 9-10)
generation.gap_death_sites: 1x the call named no template for the pick
